results.snippet:
Lulululu - Calm bedtime stories for bilingual kids

# Calm bedtime stories for bilingual kids.

## Beautiful, simple mobile app

## Line by line, in every language

Each line of every story is heard back to back in every language you choose — up to 3 at once. Children pick up new words by hearing them right next to ones they already know.

"Time for sleep, little one," whispered little Twinkle. “该睡觉啦，小宝贝，”小闪闪轻声说道。

interleaved bilingual storytelling

1. 5-year-olds

Hearing a story with 31 line-by-line language switches taught new words just as effectively as hearing each language in a single block.

 Brouillard et al., 2022 ↗ 
2. Ages 2 – 5

Storybooks that mix a dominant-language narrative with second-language target words support retention, with older preschoolers benefiting most.

 Read et al., 2021 ↗ 
3. Adult learners

Mixing two languages within one session outperforms studying each language in separate blocks.

 Libersky et al., 2025 ↗ 

 Read the full study notes ▾ 

 Researchers call this approach interleaved bilingual storytelling, and have tested it directly with bilingual children. In a randomized study, 5-year-olds heard a story with 31 line-by-line language switches and learned new words just as well as children who heard each language in a single block (Brouillard et al., 2022) .
